page.overview:
Who is Galall?

Galall was a male Sith Pureblood Sith Lord who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. He was part of the Imperial strike team during the events of the Conquest of Makeb acting as an armorer for fellow Sith Warriors.

Galall first appeared in the video game Star Wars: The Old Republic as a Rakata Gear vendor for the Sith Warrior class.
